The Defense portfolio included the Navy Nuclear Program and development of a conventionally armed, nuclear-propelled submarine, as well as conventional submarines, patrol vessels, frigates, border monitoring, missile systems, aircraft, and helicopters.","notes":["The excerpt says the program provided for investments; it does not establish that the funds were already allocated or spent."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-E015","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"In a September 2023 UN Security Council debate, Brazil called for de-escalation, dialogue, and a peaceful, negotiated solution to the Ukraine war; rejected threats to use nuclear weapons; highlighted risks to civilians and nuclear facilities; supported resuming the Black Sea Grain Initiative; and advocated mediation and preventive diplomacy. Brazil reported sending high representatives to Copenhagen and Jeddah and holding bilateral discussions with the parties.","notes":["The excerpt describes consequences and risks to civilians and nuclear facilities rather than explicitly calling for their protection."]}]}
